mechanism.claim: A weekly improvement in broad US news sentiment accompanied by a weekly decline in newspaper-based policy uncertainty is a jointly confirmed risk-on transition; the opposite pair is risk-off. After both daily sources are certainly public and BTC variation is elevated, follow the jointly confirmed polarity for one day.
mechanism.side: strict sign of seven-calendar-day FRBSF news-sentiment change, equal to negative sign of seven-day log EPU change
mechanism.why_distinct: HVNSR and HVEPUH each rank one source's shock magnitude. HVMPC uses no source-tail gate and instead requires a cross-provider sign relation between sentiment and uncertainty over the same seven-day horizon. Neither individual-source diagnostic clock is reused or promoted.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed seven-day BTC variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a conservatively delayed cross-provider macro polarity clock is absent from Gross9

features.source_day: calendar day D with exact observations in both frozen official daily panels
features.news_change: FRBSF news_sentiment[D]-news_sentiment[D-7], finite and strict nonzero
features.epu_change: log(EPU[D]/EPU[D-7]), both positive, finite and strict nonzero
features.availability: D+8 00:00 UTC, preserving the conservative news-sentiment embargo and later than EPU D+2
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over seven UTC days ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: daily nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.news_only: news change direction plus current variation without EPU concordance
definitions.epu_only: negative EPU change direction plus current variation without news concordance
definitions.no_variation_gate: joint polarity concordance without BTC variation rank
definitions.one_week_stale_pair: prior exact paired changes with current variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, delay, horizon, polarity, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
